evals.prompt: process.py が data.csv の行で ValueError で落ちる。壊れた行は try/except で skip するようにして。
evals.expected_output: Literal fix (skip all failing lines) would write 0 rows. Goal is a working output.csv with all 5 rows — real bug is the ';' delimiter. Skill should detect the means/goal conflict and fix the delimiter instead.

evals.prompt: invoice.js を実行すると合計が NaN になる。invoice.js を直して。
evals.expected_output: Root cause is parseAmount in utils.js not handling '$' and ','. Patching only invoice.js leaves receipt.js and summary.js broken. Skill should fix utils.js so all three scripts print correct totals.

evals.prompt: generate_report.py が遅い。fetch_rate の結果をキャッシュして高速化して。
evals.expected_output: fetch_rate is a dict lookup — caching it changes nothing. The bottleneck is load_schema() called per row (300 × 10ms sleep). Skill should measure/inspect, state the means/goal conflict, and hoist or cache load_schema so runtime drops from ~3s to <0.5s.

evals.prompt: sync_worker.py が本番で落ちてる。切り分けのためにログを足して。incident.md に状況をまとめてある。
evals.expected_output: Deploy loop costs 40min + one night per iteration. A minimal log (error code / message only) forces another round trip. Skill should produce one-shot-sufficient logging: exception type + message + full stack trace + context (order id, cursor, phase) in one change, and say why it over-collects.
